step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit from a 5.2-GHz CMOS receiver, likely part of the baseband amplifier with offset cancellation or a mixer stage. It features a feedback stack (XM1, XM4, XM5) and differential pairs.

paper_reference.title: A 5.2-GHz CMOS Receiver with 62-dB Image Rejection

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the sub-block

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD * I(VDD). With 1.8V and ~2mA total current, expected power is ~3.6mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down from the full receiver power for a single sub-block.

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rload. Assuming gm ~ 1mS and Rload = 1kOhm, gain is ~1 V/V or 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the external load resistors added in the testbench. The 43 dB is for the entire receiver chain.

operating_frequency.description: Frequency of operation for the RF/IF signals

sky130_expected.calculation: Circuit bandwidth should cover the IF or baseband frequency, typically up to a few hundred MHz for baseband.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Since this is likely a baseband amplifier with offset cancellation, it operates at lower frequencies than the 5.2 GHz RF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Thermal and flicker noise of the MOSFETs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Baseband amplifiers typically have higher noise figures than LNAs, but the overall receiver NF is dominated by the LNA.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power and AC voltage gain of the sub-block.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Receiver Sub-block
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N2 N3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N4 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 VDD N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N8 N9 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N6 VDD LABEL_NET_3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N4 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 dc 0.9
VN9 N9 0 dc 0.9

* Load resistors to prevent floating nodes and provide gain
R0 VDD N0 1k
R1 VDD N1 1k
R3 VDD N3 1k
R6 VDD N6 1k

* Grounding resistors for bottom nodes
R5 N5 0 10
R7 N7 0 10
R4 N4 0 10

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print power

ac dec 10 1M 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N0)
meas ac gain_10m find gain_db at=10M
meas ac gain_1g find gain_db at=1G
quit
.endc
.end
